feeds.title: Beatrice Brandini Blog
feeds.description: Beatrice Brandini was born in Florence. She graduated as a fashion designer with the costume designer Anna Anni and after high school she enrolled at the University of Letters with a specialization in Art History. This is her personal blog, in which the protagonists are Fashion, Art, Design, as well as the planning of trends. In a short time, the site gained space and acclaim in terms of views and prestige.

feeds.title: Florence Leather Market
feeds.description: Explore our promotions, news and offers in preview and extra sales. Florence Leather Market is your is your reference point if you are looking for top quality Italian leather products, made by leather craftsmen in Italy.

feeds.title: Polimoda Fashion School
feeds.description: Polimoda represents the high training in the fashion industry in an internationally recognized centre of excellence, located in the heart of one of the most important production areas of Made in Italy. EXplore our journal for more information on our training school, courses, events and more!

feeds.title: Eredi Chiarini Firenze
feeds.description: Discover Eredi Chiarini Firenze's suggestions for your men's fashion style. With Eredi Chiarini Firenze, buying online is an enjoyable and engaging experience. In fact you can choose from many brands, all of high quality, such as Tagliatore, Incotex, Rrd, Fay, Herno, Lardini, Jacob Cohen, Ortigni, Creed, Tintoria Mattei and many more.

feeds.title: Florence Fashion Tour
feeds.description: Discover the best fashion shopping tours in Florence. FFT (Florence Fashion Tour) offers tours and classes to experience Italian style. FFT supports the slow-fashion movement at the core of Made in Italy. During our consultancies and tours, we teach our customers to buy less but better and invest in quality clothes over quantity.

feeds.title: Girl in Florence » Fashion
feeds.description: Welcomed to my personal blog by a curious American girl with a semi-confusing name {and it's Georgette} living and working in Florence, Italy. This blog is primarily about my travels around the world, plus a generous helping of lifestyle and food tips for the city of Firenze. Explore my take on fashion in Tuscany here.

feeds.title: Monnaluna Blog
feeds.description: Handmade items with Florentine creativity and quality. Inspiration from the geometric forms of the Renaissance period with modern appeal. Stories about Monnaluna. From the roots and heritage of the founder, to the incredible stories and events from around the world, that have enriched our initial ideas to make them an essential to femininity without any barriers.
